about: Answer key for in/fixtures/季度事实清单.md, written with it before any run (2026-11-08). kit.py checks at import that every fact pattern here is found in the list. Patterns are Python regular expressions; an item counts when all its groups match inside one unit (a table row, a list item with its sub-items, or a sentence) of the report, together with the heading it sits under. The tone lists follow the patterns of humanizer-zh (op7418/Humanizer-zh, after Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing: AI vocabulary, significance inflation, promotional language, filler, generic positive endings, negative parallelism, forced triples) and the boilerplate of Chinese work reports.
